meta.name: learn-profile
meta.description: Inspect a reference repo and save its nyann-relevant setup (stack, hooks, branching, commit convention, extras) as a reusable profile. TRIGGER when the user says "save this setup as a profile called X", "learn a profile from ~/projects/foo", "capture this repo's setup as my-profile", "make a profile from this repo", "turn this repo into a profile", "extract a profile from <path>", "remember this setup as <name>", "/nyann:learn-profile". Do NOT trigger on "what does this profile do?" — that's `inspect-profile`. Do NOT trigger on "apply profile X to this repo" — that's `bootstrap-project`. Do NOT trigger on "fix drift" — that's `retrofit`.
